How can traders study a possible market bottom without relying on just one indicator?
In this Tuesday Technical Talk, Vishal B Malkan revisits the ADX indicator discussed in the previous session and explains how he combines it with candlestick structure, divergence, support zones, and multi-timeframe analysis to study possible trend reversals. 

The Nifty analysis begins with the monthly, weekly, and daily charts. Vishal highlights support zones, a previous spinning top/Doji, bullish engulfing structure, outside-inside patterns, double-bottom behaviour, volatility divergence, and the recent turn in ADX as part of his technical framework. 

The session then expands into a top-down global market analysis, covering the Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq, European markets, Asian indices, Gold, Silver, Bitcoin, Crude Oil, and Dollar/INR. 

A major part of the discussion focuses on the relationship between the Dollar/INR chart and Nifty. Vishal uses candlestick patterns and momentum changes in the dollar as additional context while explaining his market-bottom framework.

The key takeaway is:
Don’t rely on a single signal. Study price, momentum, patterns, divergence, support, and broader market context together.
